newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali sees lower '97 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali sees lower '97 earnings growth.

text.p: Austrian insurer EA-Generali said on Thursday it expected lower earnings growth in 1997 due to a decline in its life insurance business.

"We can't assume that the development of earnings will continue this year as it did in 1996," chief executive Dietrich Karner told a news conference shortly after the group reported a 25 percent increase in net profit to 600 million schillings.
Karner said premiums were more likely to sink to 1995 levels as a result of a decline in the single-premium business.
The dividend for 1996 looked set to remain unchanged at 17 schillings, the Italian-controlled company said.
"We have always honoured the principle of dividend continuity. However we are going through some hard times so we have to give priority to asset-building," Karner said.
Last year's gain in earnings was driven by a strong increase in life insurance income, as Austrians scrambled to buy policies before a tax change came into effect in May 1996.

In Austria, EA-Generali reported a 61 percent jump in life insurance premiums. Total group premiums were up at 42.7 billion schillings, from 36.88 billion a year earlier, the group said. While margins remained slim in the life insurance business, Karner said most other business areas had also developed positively and contributed to the rise in earnings.

With regard to assets the group was bracing itself for a difficult premium war in Europe, he said. The company aims to strengthen customer relations through better services. Costs were under control, it said.
In Germany, EA-Generali's second biggest market, the downtrend in premiums continued. Premium sales of the company's five German subsidiaries rose by 4.6 percent to 11.16 billion schillings in 1996.

EA-Generali's shares were the top decliner on the Vienna bourse on Thursday, falling 40 schillings to close at 3,380 in an otherwise stable market. The group is majority-controlled by Italy's Assecurazioni Generali SpA.
